claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting tidal volume 6-8 mL/kg predicted body weight and plateau pressure <30 cmH2O.
Maintain SpO2 92-96% and consider weaning FiO2 from 50% as tolerated; avoid hyperoxia.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate to assess ventilation, oxygenation, and perfusion.
Monitor blood glucose closely and continue insulin therapy to maintain glucose 140-180 mg/dL.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, ionized calcium) and replace as needed.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium screening (CAM-ICU) with goal RASS 0 to -1.
Assess and manage pain using multimodal analgesia, targeting a tolerable pain level.
Monitor hemodynamics (arterial blood pressure, central venous pressure, heart rate) and continue vasopressor support as needed to maintain mean arterial pressure ≥65 mmHg.
Perform chest physiotherapy and incentive spirometry; encourage mobilization as tolerated.
Monitor for signs of infection and continue current antimicrobial therapy; reassess culture results when available.
